cards.art: wise owl atop cracked Greek amphora
cards.lore: Aristotle called us political animals. He meant it as a compliment. We have complicated the assessment.
cards.name: The City-State
cards.power: Ostracism: Exile any player who becomes too powerful. The audience talks back.

cards.art: armored wolf-general wading river in full battle splatter
cards.lore: The Republic survived the crossing. The political reality did not.
cards.name: The Caesar
cards.power: The Worked Shoot: Violate the constitution publicly. Generals must disband armies; you kept yours.

cards.art: sly fox in doublet holding dagger and quill
cards.lore: Everyone sees what you appear to be; few experience what you really are.
cards.name: The Machiavelli
cards.power: The Prince: Perform virtue while doing the terrible thing. Do it all at once.

cards.art: walrus general in Prussian uniform smoking cigar
cards.lore: Give them the performance of representation and they won't notice the absence of substance.
cards.name: The Bismarck
cards.power: Realpolitik: The election is theater. You are the machinery.

cards.art: hyena on soapbox roaring into megaphone at crowd
cards.lore: I alone can fix it. The institutions are the enemy. You are with me or you are with them.
cards.name: The Populist
cards.power: The Rally: Convert every action into a performance. Reality checks require a BLÖDSINN! roll.

cards.art: bespectacled beaver with calculator and clipboard
cards.lore: The data suggests your anger is statistically insignificant.
cards.name: The Expert
cards.power: The Briefing: Establish expertise. Your next action cannot be challenged on facts, only on tone.

cards.art: cockroach in tuxedo raising champagne amid mushroom cloud
cards.lore: I have served under seven Prime Ministers. I intend to serve under several more.
cards.name: The Talleyrand
cards.power: Institutional Memory: Reactivate a played card at half strength. You know where the bodies are buried.

cards.art: earnest lamb marching with CHANGE NOW! sign
cards.lore: This is worth doing even if it costs me everything. (Spoiler: It will).
cards.name: The Believer
cards.power: Conviction: Your narrative cannot be redirected. You hold the line until you burn out.

cards.art: spider at center of web made from old mobile phones
cards.lore: I'm going to need you to make some calls. No, different calls.
cards.name: The Handler
cards.power: The Network: Connect any two cards. Resolve a problem immediately without a roll.

cards.art: chameleon painting over overflowing trash cans on brick wall
cards.lore: It's not a lie. It's a curated sequence of factual elements.
cards.name: The Narrative Manager
cards.power: The Line to Take: Pre-narrate the response to a disaster. +1 Defense against reality.

cards.art: sloth stamping DENIED in towering paperwork avalanche
cards.lore: Ministers come and go. We remain.
cards.name: The Permanent Secretary
cards.power: The Briefing Pack: Add a 'Consideration' to any action. Three Considerations make action impossible.

cards.art: fat cat in pinstripe suit pouring champagne into ballot box
cards.lore: I didn't buy the politician. I invested in a shared value system.
cards.name: The Access
cards.power: The Invisible Hand: Amplify a card's effect. The access is invisible; the results are real.

cards.art: preening peacock admiring mirror while backdrop burns
cards.lore: It's not a disorder if it wins elections.
cards.name: The Grandiose
cards.power: The Mirror: You must begin every turn talking about yourself. If accepted, +1 Power.

cards.art: coiled snake moving chess pieces on board
cards.lore: Have no fixed position. Have no genuine belief. Win.
cards.name: The Strategist
cards.power: The Frame: Reframe a failure as a strategic necessity. Can only be blocked by checking Plausibility.

cards.art: shark in business suit with predatory grin
cards.lore: Stress immunity is a leadership asset. So is lack of empathy.
cards.name: The Cold Heart
cards.power: No Brakes: Immune to emotional appeals. Can only be stopped by mechanics, not morals.

cards.art: ornate gilded mirror reflecting crown in dark void
cards.lore: The audience believes the performance. The performer believes the audience.
cards.name: Item: The Echo Chamber
cards.power: Feedback Loop: Double the effect of any Narcissist card.

cards.art: dead cat placed on formal dining table amid horrified guests
cards.lore: If you are losing the argument, throw a dead cat on the table. Now everyone is talking about the cat.
cards.name: Distraction Tactic
cards.power: Shock Value: Suspend the current losing narrative. Force everyone to address the Cat.

cards.art: beaver splitting stone heart with sledgehammer
cards.lore: Make them choose between their values and their friends.
cards.name: Division Tactic
cards.power: Split Vote: Break an alliance between two other cards. They must operate independently.

cards.art: trench-coat rat at backstage microphone in curtained alcove
cards.lore: Trial balloon? Hostile disclosure? It's not gossip if it's anonymous.
cards.name: Information Tactic
cards.power: Deniability: Play face down. Reveal information later. The source is never identified.

cards.art: weasel in tuxedo hurling grenade and vanishing in POOF cloud
cards.lore: I'm glad you asked that question, because the real issue is…
cards.name: Evasion Tactic
cards.power: Redirection: Reduce the effect of a negative card by 50% and change the topic.

cards.art: squid spraying black NO-smoke above court documents and gavel
cards.lore: I did not do *that* specific thing, in *that* specific way.
cards.name: The Lawyer's Edit
cards.power: Technicality: Negate an accusation based on wording, not substance.

cards.art: parrot in suit at podium with bridge behind
cards.lore: Let me be very clear about my position (without stating the position).
cards.name: The Bridge
cards.power: Fill Time: Consume an opponent's turn without giving them anything to attack.

cards.art: bureaucratic worm navigating labyrinthine tunnels inside red apple
cards.lore: It follows the letter of the law while violating its spirit entirely.
cards.name: The Regulation
cards.power: Escape: Bypass a restriction or rule for one turn.

cards.art: turtle in hard hat locking parliament doors with heavy chains
cards.lore: If the legislature is annoying you, send them home.
cards.name: The Shutdown
cards.power: Suspension: Remove the 'Parliament' deck from play for one round.

cards.art: wolf politician grinning, holding crying piglet for camera flashes
cards.lore: Kiss the baby. Ignore the diaper. Smile for the camera.
cards.name: The Photo Op
cards.power: Authenticity: Connect with the "common voter." Immune to BLÖDSINN! checks this turn.

cards.art: VOTE-painted bus racing full speed toward cliff edge
cards.lore: Spontaneity is organized. The organization is invisible.
cards.name: The Barnstorm
cards.power: Momentum: If you keep moving, they can't ask questions.

cards.art: flaming podium on empty stage, timer frozen at 00:00
cards.lore: It's not about policy. It's about who sighs louder.
cards.name: The Showdown
cards.power: Soundbite: Win the round by being Persuasive, not Accurate.

cards.art: army of ants knocking on tree-stump door with clipboards
cards.lore: Twitter isn't real life. This is real life.
cards.name: The Knock
cards.power: Turnout: Add +1 to any die roll through sheer volume of labor.

cards.art: turtle at podium reading recipe book to cobwebbed senators
cards.lore: I will read this recipe for pot liquor until you give up.
cards.name: The Delay
cards.power: Obstruction: No cards can be played while the Filibuster is active.

cards.art: hooded figure toppling throne into swirling dark water
cards.lore: We do not believe this government should continue.
cards.name: The Regicide
cards.power: Vote: Force a majority vote. If lost, the current Leader is suspended.

cards.art: cricket chirping at podium in vast empty parliamentary chamber
cards.lore: Stop what you are doing and prove you exist.
cards.name: The Count
cards.power: Disruption: Cancel an opponent's action by demanding a headcount.

cards.art: humans fleeing tidal wave of government memos and forms
cards.lore: We have a few thousand minor suggestions.
cards.name: Paperwork
cards.power: Overload: Bury an action in so much process it essentially dies.

cards.art: suited politicians roasting marshmallows over flaming dumpster
cards.lore: Never let a good crisis go to waste. Who benefits?
cards.name: The Emergency
cards.power: Forced Position: No neutrality allowed. You must declare a side or lose power.

cards.art: enormous magnifying glass examining empty white room
cards.lore: We will report in 18 months. By then, everyone will have forgotten.
cards.name: The Commission
cards.power: Freeze: All cards on stage are frozen until a "Finding" is narrated.

cards.art: cat and dog tied at tail by rope, both furious
cards.lore: We agree on nothing. We are governing together.
cards.name: The Marriage
cards.power: Joint Custody: Two players must narrate every move together. If they disagree, it fails.

cards.art: skeleton falling from ornate cobwebbed wardrobe
cards.lore: The scandal isn't what they did. It's the hypocrisy.
cards.name: The Reveal
cards.power: Silence: The affected player cannot speak directly; they must use a 'Spokesperson'.

cards.art: roller coaster crashing off track, riders screaming
cards.lore: The numbers come in. The meaning is different for everyone.
cards.name: The Reckoning
cards.power: Resolution: Resolve all pending provocations. No more spin.

cards.art: gloved formal hand holding white handkerchief
cards.lore: The loser must say the system works. Otherwise, it doesn't.
cards.name: The Exit
cards.power: Stabilize: If performed graciously, the game stabilizes. If refused, chaos ensues.

cards.art: suited zombie rising from 1998-dated gravestone
cards.lore: You won't have Nixon to kick around anymore. (Wait, he's back).
cards.name: The Return
cards.power: Second Act: Re-enter the game with a sympathy bonus.

cards.art: reptilian and human hands shaking amid olive branches
cards.lore: The hands are real. What happens next is just not written yet.
cards.name: The Peace
cards.power: Truce: Suspend all Monster cards for one round.

cards.art: cockroach operative clutching folder of incriminating photographs
cards.lore: I'm just sharing information. The information speaks for itself.
cards.name: Weapon: Blackmail
cards.power: Recontextualize: Force an opponent to accept a negative interpretation of their past moves.

cards.art: microphone producing lightning feedback on dramatically lit empty stage
cards.lore: I have said the thing. Now you have to live with it.
cards.name: Weapon: Principle
cards.power: Truth Bomb: Sacrifice your position to shift the narrative 3 steps toward Truth.

cards.art: shadowed hand passing gold coins through dark stone archway
cards.lore: It's already done. I made some calls.
cards.name: Weapon: Debt
cards.power: Auto-Resolve: Fix one problem instantly. No questions asked.

cards.art: sweating pig receiving rolled script from spotlit director hand
cards.lore: Stick to the grid. Don't answer the question asked.
cards.name: Weapon: Script
cards.power: Pre-Narration: Define the reality before it happens.

cards.art: politician in patriotic luchador mask adjusting tie
cards.lore: The performance of power is the source of power.
cards.name: The Fiction
cards.power: Belief: If the table believes the lie, it becomes the rule.

cards.art: bear paws shredding government briefing documents mid-table
cards.lore: The moment the mask slips. Dangerous. Valuable.
cards.name: The Break
cards.power: Realness: Break the game rules to say something true. High risk.

cards.art: cartoon rabbit drawing frame around itself with pencil
cards.lore: Politics is a game. Don't hate the player, hate the dev team.
cards.name: The Frame
cards.power: Perspective: Change the victory conditions of the current scene.

cards.art: feet of multiple voters visible under voting booth curtains
cards.lore: The curtain is thin. The curtain is the point.
cards.name: The Ritual
cards.power: Civilization: Reset the chaos. We agree to this so we don't kill each other.

cards.art: bull wrestler screaming into vintage microphone
cards.lore: You people make me sick! (Cheer for me).
cards.name: Promo: Aggro
cards.power: Connection: Works exactly like the Demagogue.

cards.art: ghostly hand moving chess pieces amid falling currency
cards.lore: The market decided. (I am the market).
cards.name: Promo: Market
cards.power: Connection: Synergizes with The Donor.

cards.art: upside-down bat in tuxedo dripping ink into jar
cards.lore: You invited me in. Now we discuss terms.
cards.name: Promo: Parasite
cards.power: Connection: The Lobbyist's true form.

cards.art: frantic hamster running wheel going nowhere fast
cards.lore: Let's circle back to that. Forever.
cards.name: Promo: Stasis
cards.power: Connection: The Bureaucrat's ultimate defense.

title: Politics — The Starter Set of Doom: 5,000 Years of Bad Ideas & One Very Tired Ballot Box
